arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Dubin argued the trustee relies on a different code provision because the primary claim is time-barred.
Ms. Blatt argued the waiver language directly relates to the avoidance powers in the code.
Ms. Dubin asserted the trustee has an array of avoidance powers under the Bankruptcy Code.
Justice Gorsuch noted the language supporting the side that brought the case's view is not present in the specific statute.
